name: BCL6 corepressor
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: BCOR encodes BCL-6 corepressor. Annotated molecular activities include transcription corepressor activity and DNA-binding transcription factor binding. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to microphthalmia, syndromic 2 (x-linked).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Retinoblastoma; Acute myeloid leukemia; Endometrial stromal sarcoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: X-linked; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
